data.headline: These 2 Billionaires Just Bought My Favorite Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock
data.summary: Watching the moves of billionaire hedge fund managers is a wise investment strategy because these investors didn't get to their status without making some smart decisions.  Funds that have more than $100 million in assets must disclose their end-of-quarter holdings to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) within 45 days after that quarter ends, and those disclosures are then made available to the public.  One stock that two billionaires I follow both bought in the third quarter is Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (NYSE: TSM), which is one of my favorite ways to invest in the artificial intelligence (AI) arms race.
